To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1. We propose Pixelated Butterfly, a simple and efficient sparse training method based on flat block and low-rank matrix factorization.

Pixelated Butterfly (a) is a simple, effective, and fast sparse model training method for most layers of a neural network, (b) is $3\ties$ faster than Butterfly on hardware, (c) achieves favorable accuracy-efficiency tradeoffs on ImageNet and WikiText-2, and (d) is the first method to sparsify the MLP-Mixer and Vision Transformer.
Pixelated Butterfly sparsifies most layers in a model, including attention and MLP, and achieves faster training speed and accuracy comparable to dense models.
